entry_points.text: Grace thread entry drives wait, init retry with voluntary scheduling, forcing loop, and cleanup, warning on pending signal during wait.

Quiescence check refreshes tracking and reports upward only with obligation plus observed quiescence; scheduler tick validates monotonic time under debug, consumes urgent request, delegates to flavor, triggers core on pending work, and records user or idle interruption as voluntary switch; one flavor manages deferred versus immediate reports with rescheduling, the other reports on user, idle, or nested entry.

Core processing handles deferred reports, advancement, invocation, stall checks, and offload wakeups with softirq delegation and strict clean-reader queueing; strict work provides a quiescent point via minimal read section; leak callback is a no-op target.
Early boot establishes per-CPU identity, baselines, and deferred linkage with optional nocb queue, lock, and timer setup.

exports.text: Poll support captures current full-state snapshot and arms shared polling; companion accessor returns an already-satisfied normal and expedited snapshot.
Conditional wait blocks for a full period unless the supplied snapshot already polls complete.
CPU online preparation establishes sequencing and quiescent bookkeeping and reports numeric success.
Scheduler-tick handler is globally visible, runs on calling CPU with interrupts disabled, and drives tick accounting plus flavor handling.

hazards.text: Advancing global sequence after leaf scan could miss a concurrently onlining CPU and reclaim too early, so start precedes hotplug scan with root sequence lagging for single-node correctness; sync cleanup bounds completions per pass and defers remainder to background work, releasing trailing separator only when acquire read shows no pending cleanups.

Stall handling emits notifiers, console and trace diagnostics, stack dumps, blocked-task listings, forced broadcasts, and conditional panic, avoids hard-lockup detector during verbose output under locks, warns once on offline, count, or segment inconsistency, and anticipates memory exhaustion under prolonged grace-thread deprivation with periodic kick past deadline.

Control vocabulary distinguishes idle, reconcile, init, forcing-wait, and forcing phases, explicit and overload forcing requests, boost arming delay, per-pass sync completion bound, init flag, wait, done-wait, cleanup, and cleaned states, done and next-ready tails, stall rat delay, and stall notify code.
Starvation threshold is twice ticks per second; barrier throttle spacing is one sixteenth of ticks per second.

invariants.text: Sync init inserts separator at head when ordinary waiters exist and publishes it as wait tail, requesting repoll when unavailable; cleanup completes bounded prefix up to next separator, releases trailing separator when no background work remains, publishes done tail, and queues deferred cleanup with pending accounting.

Init validates start request under root lock, records stall timing, inserts separator, advances global sequence, then reconciles each leaf under hotplug exclusion by applying buffered baseline, setting up newly online branches, retaining blocked waits, and propagating fully offline branches upward.

Bring-up copies baseline need to current need, publishes new sequence, refreshes local view, arms boost window, validates blocked state, reports offline or blocked leaf need under lock, broadcasts strict boundary, and reports own quiescence with preemption disabled; minimal builds reduce checks and diagnostics to emptiness assertions.

Forcing wakes on overload, explicit request, or empty root need, sleeps on dedicated queue with computed deadline, snapshots idle state on first pass, probes each outstanding member once per leaf, reports collected masks under lock, kicks reschedule set after unlock, and clears single-shot request under root.

Cleanup closes polled snapshot, publishes completed sequence breadth-first after validating emptiness, folds future need, re-evaluates overload, hands off deferred state, returns to idle, and re-arms when new need appears; nocb wait uses per-node queue pair selected by sequence parity with barrier-paired wake, disabled to empty and null in one build.

Per-CPU check reports upward only with outstanding obligation plus observed quiescence; pending suppresses full-dynticks idle or user and patience window, else signals on obligation, ready callbacks, completion hint, idle queue, or sequence change; full-dynticks is ignorable only shortly after start.

Batch sampling reads clock on few iterations with optional jiffies deadline; invocation extracts ready segment under protection, invokes outside with ordering and cleared pointer, returns unreached work to done segment, adapts limit by backlog divisor with minimum, manages watermarks and invoked counts, and warns once on offline or count inconsistency; invoker identity compares current against per-CPU and offload tasks.

Boot establishes per-CPU identity, baselines, and deferred linkage with optional nocb queue, lock, and timer init; online prepare serializes under root then leaf locks; grace thread joins housekeeping set only under full dynticks; lazy handling defaults from build with forced disable in one config.

Barrier entrainment runs with interrupts disabled under global barrier lock; callbacks mark records with last completion signaling once; requests throttle in time with idle sleep and early exit; parameter trigger rejects before scheduler readiness and counts concurrent users.

Expedited uses one global plus at most one parallel worker per node with node-local affinity and elevated scheduling, leaving existing workers unchanged; per-node boost thread is created and woken once in one build and absent in the other; softirq selection creates no per-CPU threads and starts work flags cleared.

Stall check skips when suppressed or inactive, samples sequence, deadline, and start with barriers, aborts on change or early time, lets one winner claim report via compare-exchange while filtering pauses and re-arming deadline; blocked-task report gathers bounded references under lock then inspects after unlock; stack dump walks leaves and aborts on sequence change; starvation declares after twice tick rate.

locks.text: Start decisions use root lock with interrupts disabled; leaf reconcile adds hotplug exclusion plus leaf lock; breadth-first setup holds each node lock with saved interrupts; teardown and setup require leaf lock held and acquire parents toward root without enabling interrupts.

Forcing scans hold one leaf lock at a time, reporting via lock-consuming path or releasing when idle, clearing single-shot request under root; cleanup walks breadth-first under each node lock; batch extract and accounting run under nocb lock with interrupts disabled, releasing across invocation with tick dependency held.

Stall inspection disables interrupts and takes each leaf lock with saved state while examining masks and blocked lists, releasing before slow inspection, dumps, or console output; self report takes leaf for diagnostics and root for deadline re-arm.

Barrier entrainment runs with interrupts disabled under global barrier lock; online prepare serializes initial setup under root lock then leaf association under leaf lock; boost publication holds node lock with saved interrupts while expedited and boost creation share node thread mutex.

state_machines.text: Global progress moves idle, hotplug reconcile, init, timed forcing wait, active forcing, back to idle; grace thread publishes wait then done-wait around init retries, loops forcing, then publishes cleanup and cleaned around cleanup and never returns.

Forcing sleeps on dedicated queue with computed deadline, wakes on overload, explicit request, or empty root need, forces when deadline expired or request or overload present, else treats wake as stray and shortens wait; first pass snapshots idle, later passes recheck; distinct forcing-wait state expires past deadline by stall-suspicion interval while queued out.
Per-CPU thread cycles waiting, running, and yielding, with parking moving it off-CPU; execution repeats bounded drain attempts before brief yield.

structs.text: Tree node carries current, baseline, and next-baseline needs, blocked-wait flag, parent link, group mask, CPU interval, level, published sequence, completion marker, blocked-task anchors, overload and offline-need masks, offload queue pair, and protecting lock.

Global grace state carries name, global and polled sequences, request flags, activity and start stamps, stall, forcing, and reschedule deadlines, extension allowance, force counters with baseline, maximum duration, end stamp, phase value, wait queue, thread pointer, tree storage, hotplug exclusion, overload latches, and sync-wait list with wait and done tails, pending counter, and cleanup work.

Per-CPU record carries node pointer with sequence and wrap tracking, obligation and observed flags, callback list with watermarks, batch limits with invoked counts, thread status with work flag and task pointers, tick counts with urgent flag and last stamp; thread control adds status, work byte, activity stamp, and hotplug hooks; stall snapshot adds interrupt, softirq, system times and counters keyed by sequence; barrier parameter pairs get and set operations with shared atomic user count.
